Cyclone Arnab brings heavy rain to Chhattisgarh, breaks records

Cyclone Arnab caused severe weather in Chhattisgarh, with 60 mm of rain recorded in 24 hours. Jagdalpur saw rainfall records broken for the last 6 years, while Raipur's rainfall record for the past 2 years was also broken. An alert has been issued for the state.
